narrative: Builders on Hugging Face shipped 6,920 new Spaces this week (+6.9%), and the named use cases they chose lean toward conversation and knowledge work: chat and assistants at 1,075, data analysis at 548, document AI at 463 and search and research at 423. Image generation is the one named use case running the other way at 693 (−5.6%). Technique shares tilt the same direction, with agentic Spaces at 6.6% of the week and vision-language and multimodal both lower in points. Media and entertainment is the most-served vertical at 9.9%; healthcare sits at 4.0%. Tooling stays Static-and-Gradio heavy, with Docker the fastest-moving runtime at +16.7%.
